requirement:
Sections use `section`, named from whitespace-normalized heading text. ATX and
setext headings are supported. Content before the first heading can form an
anonymous section. Section nesting follows heading levels; other outline items
appear beneath their nearest enclosing container. Selectors follow
{cite}`requirements.references.outline_selectors`.
rationale:
I judge the tests adequate for `requirements.sdk.sources.markdown.sections`. I did not request implementation source, because the supplied test text was enough to map each obligation. Each obligation below has a test that exercises it and asserts the outcome.

- **Kind `section`, named from whitespace-normalized heading text:**
  - `markdown_profile_nests_sections_by_heading` in `outline/tests.rs` asserts `section[Head%20*one*]` for the heading `Head  *one*`, which collapses the double space.
  - The same test checks that the structural hash is stable when the text is reflowed.
  - `markdown_sections_include_setext_headings_and_anonymous_preamble` asserts `section[Heading%20words]` for `Heading   words`.
  - `multiline_setext_sections_keep_original_source_spans_and_skip_code` asserts `section[Títle%20two]` for a two-line setext heading, so newline-to-space normalization is covered.
  - `markdown_heading_levels_resolve_encoded_duplicates_and_anonymous_items` asserts percent-encoding of special characters (`/ [ ] # @ %`) and `#1`/`#2` duplicate disambiguation. These cover selector conformance with `requirements.references.outline_selectors`.
- **ATX and setext headings:**
  - ATX headings are covered in several tests.
  - Setext level 1 (`===`) is covered in `markdown_sections_include_setext_headings_and_anonymous_preamble`.
  - Setext level 2 (`---`) is covered in the `Level two` case in `markdown_heading_levels_resolve_encoded_duplicates_and_anonymous_items`.
  - Multi-line setext headings, and setext headings inside directives, block quotes and lists, are covered in `multiline_setext_sections_keep_original_source_spans_and_skip_code` and `setext_sections_inside_directives_lists_and_quotes_retain_container_spans`.
  - The second of these also checks the span start and the selected text.
  - A `===` line inside a fenced code block is not treated as a heading, and that is asserted.
- **Anonymous section for content before the first heading:**
  - `markdown_sections_include_setext_headings_and_anonymous_preamble` asserts the first section selector starts with `section@`.
  - `markdown_heading_levels_resolve_encoded_duplicates_and_anonymous_items` checks the same, and also checks that the preamble text is `préface`.
  - `markdown_profile_nests_sections_by_heading` covers a preamble that follows front matter.
- **Nesting follows heading levels:**
  - A skipped level (`#` then `###`) nests `Deep` under `Main`.
  - Same-level siblings (`Same` twice) are tested.
  - A return to a shallower level (`# End` after `##`) is tested.
  - A setext level-2 section under `# End`, followed by `## Peer` as its sibling, is tested.
  - A section that ends at the next heading is tested through the `!contains("# Last")` and `!contains("first")` assertions.
- **Other outline items appear beneath their nearest enclosing container:**
  - `paragraphs_and_nested_directives_have_independent_source_ranges` asserts the full parent-index tree: paragraph and block under section, paragraph under block, and block under block.
  - `markdown_heading_levels_resolve_encoded_duplicates_and_anonymous_items` asserts a block selector of `section[End]/section[Level%20two]/block@…`.
  - `markdown_profile_nests_sections_by_heading` asserts paragraphs under their sections.
- **Selectors resolve:** `resolve` and `select` are used throughout, and the `paragraphs_and_nested_directives_have_independent_source_ranges` loop checks that every node's selector resolves back to its index.

I found no input class named by the requirement that lacks a test with an assertion.
